decisionRule: Preserve one canonical authority and one durable execution model. Reuse behavior only when it improves measurable safety, reliability, traceability or user value without importing a second runtime.
licenseBoundary: No direct source-code adoption is claimed because the original archives and independently verified licenses are not contained in this workspace.
